_meta.description: CSS selector fallbacks for chatgpt.com ProseMirror composer. Patch 4 of 6 from agentify-sh/desktop deep-dive. Adapted from agentify-sh/desktop (algorithm only, public domain). Each element lists 5-13 fallback selectors; the consumer merges them comma-separated into a single CSS query that matches the FIRST element on the page. Add new fallbacks to the END of each list to keep the priority order stable.
_meta.schema: Each element has 'fallbacks' (ordered list). The first entry is treated as the canonical primary container used for composer composition; comma-joining all fallbacks produces the multi-fallback chain (used by tools that resolve via querySelectorAll and pick first).

promptTextarea.description: Main composer where user types the prompt

stopButton.description: Stop generating button (visible while assistant is streaming)

assistantMessage.description: Container + inline elements of the assistant's reply

composerRoot.description: Outer container that wraps the prompt textarea + send button

_fieldSelectors.description: Per-element sub-selectors for splitting assistant reply into text + code blocks. Used by extract_reply / extract_code_blocks.
